description: Fetch one Seraphix public record by ID, with everything needed to cite and check it: the claim, the verbatim quote, source_url, source title, publisher and locator, source_date, published_at, the primary document, supporting quotes from other filings, the dated history of filings stating the same thing, every version (superseded versions keep their reason and correction source), tier, and a ready-made citation. Record IDs look like SX-07-A-0001. An unknown ID returns an error (isError) saying so; IDs are never reused. Free under the toll, no key needed.
name: get_record

cite.description: Cite this: the attribution line for this response (CC BY 4.0). Records: cite each by its record_url.

status.description: OBSERVED = the source object validated and is within its freshness window. DEGRADED = late, missing or invalid; values may be older than expected.

claim.description: One-line statement of what the source says.

website.description: The company's official website, as stated in its latest annual report and checked to answer on the company's own domain. null when not known; never guessed.

company_stated.description: True when the record is a company-stated expectation or plan: what the company said, not a verified outcome.

fields.description: Structured fields extracted from the source (for site records: site, location, mw, status).

id.description: Stable Seraphix record ID, e.g. SX-07-A-0001. Never reused.

published_at.description: Date Seraphix first published the record.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the source document, or null when the source has no quotable line.

source_date.description: Date of the source document (published, reported or effective, in that order of preference).

source_type.description: secondary = the cited source is a press outlet or law-firm summary, not the primary document.

source_url.description: The source document the record cites.

tag.description: ENACTED, STATED, COMPANY DISCLOSURE, MARKER or REPORTED · PRIMARY PENDING.

tier.description: reviewed = passed the Seraphix review gate (approved, source hash verified). unreviewed = published without that gate.

title: Get one record with history
